steps.en: Start Jaeger: one container with collector, query service, UI and in-memory storage
steps.zh: 启动 Jaeger：一个容器里有采集器、查询服务、界面和内存存储

steps.en: Instrument each service with the OpenTelemetry SDK and export spans over OTLP
steps.zh: 用 OpenTelemetry SDK 给各服务埋点，经 OTLP 发 span

steps.en: Receives spans from every service, batches them and writes them to trace storage
steps.zh: 接收各服务发来的 span，攒批写入链路存储

steps.en: Joins spans that share a trace ID into one end-to-end request timeline
steps.zh: 把同一 trace ID 的 span 拼成一条端到端的请求时间线

steps.en: Search by service, operation, tag or duration and open the slow trace
steps.zh: 按服务、操作、标签或耗时搜索，打开那条慢请求

value.en: One slow request across a dozen services shows exactly which call, in which service, ate the time
value.zh: 一个跨十几个服务的慢请求，能直接看出时间耗在哪个服务的哪一次调用上

sources: https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger README (Quick Start: docker run jaegertracing/jaeger:latest with ports 16686/4317/4318, all-in-one includes UI, collector, query, in-memory storage; Architecture: OpenTelemetry SDK -> collector -> storage <- query <- UI)
https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/main/cmd/jaeger/config.yaml (otlp/jaeger/zipkin receivers, batch processor, jaeger_storage_exporter, jaeger_query extension)
